body:
READ-ONLY RECALLSIGNATURE ESTIMAND AUDIT — no edits/claims/reservations. The externalMass/unranked defect is already filed and not duplicated. Four additional P1 candidates and one lower-priority support gap follow; chief owns routing.

1. NO ELIGIBLE ROUTE IS PUBLISHED AS A PERFECT ROUTE. signature.scala:104-116 makes discourseChronology=ordered(...).getOrElse(1.0); :144-159 gives a step with zero source→source mass coherence=1.0 and an empty flow semanticFlow=1.0. backwardMean at :108-109 divides by all steps; worldBackward at :116 is Some(0.0) whenever a world-order map exists even if no comparable transition exists. Live public-path probe: a one-unit unrankable recall inferred by GraphHsmm produced (unrankedMass=1.0, discourseChronology=1.0, worldChronology=None, semanticFlowCoherence=1.0, compression=0.0, fidelity=None, specificity=None, backwardMass=0.0, worldBackwardMass=Some(0.0)). The aligner never ranked the unit and there was no transition, yet the participant appears perfectly chronological/coherent, uncompressed, and non-backtracking. Exact sibling of absent admissibility = gate success. Required: Missing/abstention plus eligible source-transition mass/count; conditional route values must travel with that support.

2. FIDELITY HAS THE SAME 0.5 CLIFF AS INTERVIEW PROFILE; SPECIFICITY RENORMALIZES ARBITRARILY SMALL SOURCE RESIDUE. At :69-86 fidelity includes a unit only when sourceMass > externalMass, assesses only the MAP anchor/mode, and averages the surviving units; localizability renormalizes within source mass (matrix.scala:154-174) and RecallSignature carries no source-resolution condition. Using HsmmResult.validated on a real admitted Anna anchor: 0.51 source/0.49 external => fidelity=Some(1.0), perUnitMode contains u2, specificity=Some(1.0); 0.49/0.51 => fidelity=None, no perUnitMode, specificity still Some(1.0); 0.01 source/0.99 external => specificity=Some(1.0). An imperceptible change in our confidence erases fidelity, while 1% residual alignment becomes perfect specificity. Vague recalls therefore selectively vanish from fidelity and can remain maximally localizable. Required: posterior-weighted/interval fidelity or explicit abstention, and source-resolution mass inseparable from conditional specificity/fidelity.

3. COMPRESSION AND SEMANTIC COHERENCE PROMOTE CONDITIONAL RESIDUE. Compression :88-94 emits 0 for sourceMass=0 and divides level mass by sourceMass otherwise; semantic coherence :144-159 divides coherent source-flow by sourceToSourceMass. Thus tiny surviving source mass is normalized to a full-grain/full-coherence claim while the absent case receives an apparently substantive optimum/default. These should either remain joint expected masses or be explicitly named conditional values carrying resolved source/transition support. Dropping uncertainty or normalizing residue is the same trap the chief already ruled in interview.

4. SignatureProjection ERASES MISSINGNESS AND IS STRINGLY TYPED. :209-232 converts fidelity/specificity/worldChronology/causalPreservation/worldBackwardMass None to 0.0, then silently maps an unknown component name to 0.0. Live pure-unranked projection with weights on four missing components returned numeric 0.0. A scalar can therefore turn no measurement into worst performance (or best under negative weight), and a typo silently removes a term. This violates mission commitments 6 and 13 and AGENTS typed-not-stringly. Required: typed component enum; construction rejects unknown/duplicate/invalid weights; application returns an Estimate/conditional result or refuses when a required component is Missing. No default zero.

5. CAUSAL PRESERVATION HAS TWO HARD POSTERIOR CLIFFS. :121-142 first declares a source edge recalled only when both leaf visitations exceed 0.5, then hard-MAPs a unit only when sourceMass > externalMass. If edge eligibility clears but one endpoint is 0.49/0.51, preserved becomes false rather than uncertain; no placement/edge-resolution support travels with the rate. This can turn alignment uncertainty into participant causal failure. It needs soft expected preservation or explicit endpoint/edge support and abstention.

SUPPORT GAP (P2 unless chief raises): importanceWeightedCoverage :63-67 excludes Missing source importance then renormalizes known weights, with no importance coverage. FeaturesIntegrationSuite:17-44 explicitly asserts that making an unrecalled leaf importance-Missing raises weighted coverage and can equal observed zero weight. Across stories/sites where feature missingness correlates with difficulty, the score moves. Carry importance Coverage/condition; do not quote it as unconditional.

SURFACES THAT SURVIVED: uniformCoverage and the decomposed anchored/distorted/external masses preserve posterior mass rather than hard-MAP it; worldChronology itself is None when no comparable world step; causalPreservation is None when no recalled causal edge. The defect is concentrated where conditional quantities lose their condition or no-trial cases receive numeric defaults.
